title: Soulbound Blade
description: This adds the Soulbound Blade from Sneak's Blueprint Project.
body:
# Soulbound Blade

A Fabric mod that adds a single, mechanically rich weapon — the **Soulbound Blade** — with three interlocking combat systems: a life steal proc, a ghost slash ability, and a kill-streak buff.

---

## The Soulbound Blade

Craft or obtain the Soulbound Blade and wield it in combat. The weapon rewards aggressive, kill-focused play with escalating power and a dramatic lifesteal proc.

---

## Mechanics

### Soul Stacks
Every enemy you **kill** with the Soulbound Blade charges you with a Soul Stack (up to 5). Each stack passively boosts your stats:

- **+0.5 Attack Damage** per stack
- **+0.02 Movement Speed** per stack

Stacks **decay one at a time** if 10 seconds pass without a kill — keep up the pressure.

---

### Life Steal Proc
After landing **10–15 hits** (randomized per proc), the blade triggers a **life steal burst**:

- A glowing ring erupts around you, pulsing every second for **5 seconds**
- Each pulse deals **1.5 magic damage** to all enemies within 5 blocks
- You are **healed for 0.75 HP per entity** hit per pulse — the more enemies caught, the more you recover

---

### Ghost Slash (`Shift + Right Click`)
Unleash a **ghost slash** — a spectral sweep attack in front of you:

- Damages all surrounding entities for **3 damage** as the invisible arc sweeps around you
- Applies **radial knockback** to every enemy hit
- Each enemy is only hit once per sweep
- Has a **3 second cooldown**
- Paired with a full sweep animation rendered in the world
